articleTitle: D2D interference management and resource allocation scheme based on improved graph coloring
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the advent of 6G technology, the communication demand of massive devices is growing explosively. In order to reduce the load on base stations and improve network transmission efficiency, D2D (Device-to-Device) technology rapidly being developed and applied. This technology effectively reduces the base station load, improves transmission efficiency, and expands the coverage and system throughput of cellular networks through direct interconnection between devices. Therefore, this paper proposes an D2D interference management and resource allocation scheme based on improved graph coloring. The scheme constructs the interference graph by the secondary clustering of D2D user nodes and obtains the optimal channel allocation scheme by the Hungarian algorithm. The extraction algorithm increased system throughput by 16.2% and access rate by 6% from the simulation result. Form the result, this schema not only allows multiple D2D users to multiplex the same cellular user, but also manages the interference between users.

articleTitle: Research on insulator detection algorithm of YOLOv5 fused with attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: In high-voltage transmission lines, the status of insulators needs to be monitored regularly to prevent fault, and the detection of insulators is more difficult under mist conditions. In this paper, an improved lightweight YOLOV5 algorithm is proposed to achieve defect detection of insulators. First of all, the MSR algorithm is incorporated in the YOLO model to achieve the anti-fogging effect, and in order to better detect the insulator, the CBAM attention module is introduced in the Backbone part of the YOLOv5 model. Experiments show that compared with the original model, the improved YOLOv5s-CBAM detection accuracy has been improved, and the mAP value has reached 98.4%, which can better complete the insulator detection task.

articleTitle: Research on the identification of network traffic anomalies in the access layer of power IoT based on extreme learning machine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Some of the power IoT access layer network traffic anomaly identification methods have the problem of too low F1 values when facing unknown types of traffic. To this end, a limit learning machine based power IoT access layer network traffic anomaly identification method is designed. Evaluate power IoT communication security risks, clarify the dimensions of business activities, use virtualisation features, optimise access layer network deception defence mechanisms through spying operations and other means, visualise attack behaviour, and design traffic anomaly identification methods based on extreme learning machines. Test result: The mean F1 value of the designed power IoT access layer network traffic anomaly identification method is: 0.764, which indicates that the designed power IoT access layer network traffic anomaly identification method is more superior after fully combining with the limit learning machine method.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection Method Based On Improved Conditional Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: At present, the intrusion detection model mainly uses anomalous behavior to establish a library of intrusion behavior patterns, and determines whether the intrusion behavior conforms to the intrusion behavior specification by comparing the library of intrusion behavior patterns. Once there is a change in intrusion behavior or a new type of network attack, the existing intrusion detection model cannot make corresponding changes according to the actual changes. Therefore, making intrusion detection models have the ability to learn autonomously and be able to adapt to changes in the network environment to detect new types of unknown attacks has received increasing attention from many security researchers. In this paper, we propose an intrusion detection model (CGAN-RF) based on conditional generative adversarial network (CGAN) and random forest (RF). The CGAN-RF model improves the class imbalance problem of the dataset by generating samples to enhance the detection efficiency of minority and unknown classes.

articleTitle: Horizontal Pod Autoscaling based on Kubernetes with Fast Response and Slow Shrinkage
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Autoscaling is an important part of Kubernetes. Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA) schedules cluster resources according to the service load status to ensure that services are still running normally when the load increases or decreases. But the default HPA is slow and inflexible. In scenarios with large load changes, it will scale at a high frequency, resulting in a waste of cluster resources and reducing the robustness of the cluster. This paper proposes a Fast-response and Slow-shrinkage algorithm. By setting the expansion rate, tolerance, window time, etc., the flexibility of scaling is increased. When facing the pressure of a sudden increase in traffic, the rapid expansion can be optimized in minutes. The algorithm also adopts a cautious shrinking strategy to reduce and prevent failures caused by secondary access peaks.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment and Early Warning Model of University Network Public Opinion Based on Dynamic Comprehensive Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: In recent years, the number of university network public opinion events has surged, which has damaged the social image of universities and the stability of society. The establishment of risk assessment and early warning model of university online public opinion is of great significance for universities and relevant government departments to respond to public opinion events quickly. Based on the study of the development characteristics of university online public opinion events, the risk evaluation index system of university online public opinion is constructed from three dimensions of subject, carrier and object, and the public opinion early warning model is built based on the dynamic comprehensive evaluation method of life cycle theory. The study clusters the risk ratings of university online public opinion events into four categories and divides four warning levels, and the model also simplifies the process of public opinion early warning to a certain extent.

Author Keywords: Online Public Opinion in Colleges and Universities

articleTitle: College classroom attendance and teaching evaluation method based on face recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Classroom attendance in colleges and universities takes up teaching time, and classroom quality evaluation data is highly subjective. This paper develops classroom attendance and teaching quality evaluation methods in colleges and universities based on face recognition, detects and tracks the head based on face detection algorithm, and realizes dynamic attendance, attention analysis, classroom state curve and other functions. The results show that the accuracy of the evaluation method can reach 80%.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Network Intrusion Detector Using Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Network intrusion detection is a technology that detects and responds to behaviors that endanger computer security, such as collecting vulnerability information, denying access, and gaining system control beyond the legal scope. The timely detection and control of these destructive behaviors play a vital role in the overall security of the entire computer system and network environment. This paper proposes a DNN-based network intrusion prediction model based on a set of intrusion datasets simulated in a military network environment. Experiments show that the proposed method has better prediction performance than models based on GaussianNB, Decision Tree and Logistic Regression.

articleTitle: ASPP-UNet: A New Semantic Segmentation Algorithm for Thyroid Nodule Ultrasonic Image
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Thyroid nodule ultrasound image has serious noise, low contrast between different tissues, blurred boundary and irregular shape in malignant lesions. However, existing segmentation algorithms of thyroid nodule ultrasound image often have problems of coarse edge and inaccurate segmentation of small nodule. In order to segment thyroid nodules from ultrasound images more precisely, this paper proposes a new deep learning algorithm, ASPP- UN et, to achieve precise semantic segmentation of thyroid nodules from ultrasound images. In the final phase encoding ASPP module is introduced, using different void rate of atrous convolution for multi-scale features, the next sampling by using convolution instead of pooling, which can reduce the resolution of characteristic figure, can retain more detail characteristics, and use the binary cross entropy loss and damage Dice coefficient as a comprehensive loss, improve data imbalance. In the experiment, the algorithm of FeN, FusionNet, U-Net and ResUNet was repeated and compared. The experimental results showed that the ASPP-UNet model could segment thyroid nodules more precision, and the fraction of F1 score was increased from 81.7% of the original U-Net model to 90.2%. The precision was improved to 87.9%.

articleTitle: Computer network system security assessment method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the rapid development and popular utilization of computer network system, the proportion of attacks against computer network system has been increasing year by year. The traditional security vulnerability assessment method only evaluates individual vulnerabilities in isolation, and the assessment results do not reflect the degree of impact of vulnerabilities on the whole network. To address this problem this paper proposes a computer network system security assessment method, which uses the CVSSv3 evaluation index to assess vulnerabilities based on vulnerability association graph and risk matrix, while taking into account the association relationship between the fore-order vulnerability nodes, back-order vulnerability nodes and the vulnerability itself. The vulnerability correlation hazard calculated by the method can accurately reflect the degree of impact of the vulnerability on the whole computer network system, and the accuracy and effectiveness of the method is proved through experiments.

articleTitle: A Satellite Augmentation System based on LEO mega-constellation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Recent years, Low Earth Orbit(LEO) satellites has been regarded as a potential satellite navigation methods in the future due to its unique platform and orbital advantages. LEO mega-constellations has become a “new battle field” in the global competition of space strategic resources. From the perspective of navigation and positioning, the LEO mega-constellation can bring more navigation signal sources, which can enhance the performance of the existing middle and high-orbit satellite navigation system, and can also serve as a backup of the existing satellite navigation system. This paper proposes a satellite augmentation system based on LEO mega-constellation. Firstly, the current situation of global LEO mega-constellation is summarized. Secondly, based on the advantages of LEO mega-constellation, a framework of augmentation system is designed. Finally, the performance of augmentation system is simulated and analyzed. The simulation results can provide design and technical reference for the construction and development of LEO mega-constellation in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Data driven Communication Network Situation Awareness System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The rise of new technology makes the network structure increasingly complex, and the difficulty of management and maintenance increases exponentially. Situation awareness can evaluate the current situation of the whole network and predict the future change trend. Studying the acquisition implementation means, task scheduling model and hierarchical structure, and relying on the LUA script to customize the data acquisition, storage, transmission, and analysis strategies and rules, can build the communication network situation awareness system. Designing the data driven situation awareness pre-acquisition node and analysis center technology path, can adapt to the changing network needs, and provide important decision-making basis for network planning, operation assurance, problem handling, and early warning.

articleTitle: Feature extraction and multi-period classification of sea mushroom based on image information
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The phenotype of edible fungus basically relies on visual observation and empirical judgment at present, and there is still a lack of reports on the phenotypic techniques and applications for cultivation of seafood mushroom. Accurate characterization of different growth stages in the reproductive culture step of sea mushroom and rapid judgment of its growth stage is the foundation for its industrial cultivation to intelligent cultivation. In this work, a method of multi-period growth feature extraction and period classification of sea mushroom based on machine vision technology is proposed. According to the characteristics of the image itself, the method extracts 28 features of color, shape, and texture from the acquired data set. Subsequently, the KNN (K-nearest Neighbor) is utilized to classify the images represented by the selected features. The results indicated that the multi-period classification accuracy of the growth period of the mushroom image based on the comprehensive representation of the three types of features was 85%, which could better distinguish the growth period through the image, and made guidelines for the regulation of the cultivation environment.

articleTitle: Data mining for risk prediction of diabetes mellitus
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Diabetes mellitus seriously affects human health. It is necessary to reasonably estimate the risk of diabetes and treat it as early as possible. With the rapid development of information technology and the application of big data, people have acquired a large number of medical data. Making good use of data resources is helpful to the analysis and prediction of diseases. In this paper, data mining technology is applied to the analysis of medical data, and association rules that can reflect the relationship between diseases and various factors are extracted from the data to provide support for early diabetes risk prediction. The disadvantages of classical Apriori algorithm are analysed and an improved algorithm is proposed. The experimental results show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Parameter Tuning of Active Disturbance Rejection Control Based on Improved Snake Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: In the network time synchronization system of high-throughput satellite communication, the unknown large overshoot will lead to shocks or even misalignment. The introduction of Active Disturbance Rejection Control (ADRC) could solve this problem of unknown large overshoot. However, the adjustment of the ADRC parameters is complex and difficult. To address these problems, a method for parameter tuning of a time-synchronous active disturbance rejection controller based on an improved Snake Optimization(SO) algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the principle of the classical SO algorithm is analyzed, and it is found that the parameters rectified by the classical SO algorithm do not meet the performance requirements of the controller when in the case of poorly initialized populations and insufficient resources to find the optimal value. In addition, the way in which eggs are laid to generate new individuals is not the optimal way. Secondly, the elite strategy is used in the classical SO algorithm to solve the initialization problem. In the meantime, the crossover and variation operators in the genetic algorithm are used to improve the generation of new egg-laying individuals. Finally, the improved SO algorithm is experimentally compared with the classical SO algorithm and the Adaptive Genetic Algorithm(AGA). The improved SO algorithm improves the control accuracy of the rectification parameters by 19.90% over the classical SO algorithm and by 11.49% over the AGA. The experimental results show that the improved SO algorithm can improve the time synchronization performance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of DSpace Using OpenSCENARIO to Construct Scenarios in Vehicle Simulation Testing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: DSpace is a simulation system. It is a set of software and hardware working platform based on MATLAB/Simulink for control system development and hardware in the loop simulation developed by German dSP ACE company. It realizes the seamless connection with MATLAB/Simulink/RTW. In the test of ADAS function, the author found that it is difficult to expand the test in a variety of environments, and it is time-consuming and labor-intensive to manually migrate the scene from one tool to another. However, with the development of ASAM series standards, Dspace supports the import and export of static road network files (OpenDrive) in ASAM, and the static road network files of different simulators are combined through OpenDrive. However, it does not support the import and export function of dynamic scene files (OpenSCENARIO). The construction of dynamic scenes requires labor and requires high learning costs. This article is a solution to this problem. By using this solution, Dspace can use the scenarios built by OpenSCENARIO to test various international standard scenarios.

articleTitle: A Robust Deepfake Video Detection Method based on Continuous Frame Face-swapping
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Detection of deepfake videos faces serious generalization problem in real world application scenarios. Existing robust deepfake detection methods can only works on single frame image but not continuous frame videos. In this paper, we propose a robust deepfake video detection method based on continuous frame face-swapping. We design our face-swapping dataset with Delaunay triangulation and piecewise affine transform to achieve continuous frame face-swapping. We design a feature enhancement module with facial and background information covered to make the method focus on the mask fusion zone. We build our detection model with Efficient Net to extract intra-frame fusion feature and LSTM to extract inter-frame time feature. Cross-domain experiments show that our method achieves better detection AUC than existing methods, which proves our method is robust because of generalization.

articleTitle: YOLOv5 Improved Smoke Detection Algorithm *
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The impact of fire on natural resources and the ecological environment is reflected in the fact that it alters the global carbon cycle, vegetation renewal process and soil properties through a combination of natural and human factors, thereby aggravating climate change, and also seriously endangers public life and property and causes huge economic losses. In the early stage of fire, smoke is more obvious than flame, so accurate and fast smoke detection algorithm is of great significance for preventing fire. In order to meet the requirements of smoke detection accuracy and detection speed, an improved real-time smoke detection algorithm is proposed on the basis of YOLOv5. Based on the YOLOv5 network structure, the GhostNet lightweight network is used to replace the backbone network, and the prediction header is replaced by C3Ghost. The C3 module only uses a small amount of traditional convolution to generate some feature maps, which greatly reduces the network parameters and speeds up the network inference speed; the CA attention mechanism is added to the backbone network, which makes the mobile network by embedding position information into the channel attention. Get information on a larger area and avoid introducing large overhead. Compared with the original YOLOv5 network model, the average detection accuracy of the improved method is increased by 2.2%, the FPS is changed from 181.82 to 222.22 frames per second, and the number of model parameters is reduced by 51.3%. The experimental results show that this method can effectively improve the performance of the smoke detection model.

articleTitle: A Object Detection Model with Multiple Data Enhancements
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: In the object detection task, it is worth studying the direction of generating models based on sequences to improve model training effect through data enhancement methods. In this paper, a variety of sequence data noise methods are proposed, and the noise is added after the real sequence by the enhancement method to form a new sequence. Experimental results show that the proposed data enhancement method can significantly improve the performance of the model.

articleTitle: Heterogenous Center Alignment of Dual-Path Features for Text-Image Person Re-identification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Text-image person Re-identification aims at searching a target person's image through its corresponding textual descriptions. Although many current methods have made great progress, most of these methods needed auxiliary networks, have a long training time, and are unsuitable for practical industrial applications. In this paper, We propose a novel heterogenous center alignment loss (Hetero-center alignment loss) for dual-path features, one path for global features, and the other path for local features. The hetero-center alignment loss focuses on relaxing the strict constraint of sample-based alignment loss by replacing the alignment of one sample to all the other modality samples by the sample center to all the other modality sample centers, saving the training time. Specially, we first extract initial visual and textual features from the image and language backbones, respectively. Then, we design dual-path embedding learning modules to obtain global and part-level features for both text and image input. Finally, we train our network with hetero-center alignment loss, cross-modality projection match(CMPM) loss, and a cross-modality projection category (CMPC) loss to increase the similarity of text descriptions and images with the same identity. Numerous experiments conducted on the CUHK-PEDES dataset demonstrate the superiority of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Safety helmet detection algorithm in complex scenarios based on YOLOX
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the existing helmet wearing detection algorithms have many application scenarios and rich detection targets. An improved helmet detection method EPP-YOLOX based on YOLOX is proposed. Firstly, the SPP structure of YOLOX is replaced by Enhance Pyramid pooling structure to strengthen shallow feature extraction. Secondly, YOLOX multi-scale fusion structure is added, and the spatial information and semantic information extracted from the attention mechanism image are added to reduce the loss of image details Finally, the experimental results show that the average accuracy of the proposed method is as high as 93.06%, which is 3.28% higher than the original model, while the size of the model parameters is unchanged, and the detection accuracy is also greatly improved. It realizes the high-precision detection of helmet in different scenes such as weak light scene, occlusion scene and multi-target.

articleTitle: Automatic Classification of Ancient Building Components Based on PointNet++
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: In order to preserve the Forbidden City buildings., a dataset of wooden components of ancient buildings based on the point cloud of ancient buildings., combining the current state model with the standard model., is proposed., and the improved PointNet++ algorithm for point cloud deep learning is applied to train the dataset., and the training strategy is optimised with Adam W and cross-entropy loss function with label smoothing, and the PointNet++ network is found to be applicable through comparative experiments The dataset production method is found to be suitable for PointNet++ network through comparison experiments. The large number of samples required for model training is difficult and costly to collect, limiting its widespread use. The improved PointNet++ has better segmentation accuracy than the original method, and is able to automatically segment the 3D point clouds of wooden elements of ancient buildings using a small dataset containing 70 rooms and 3198 samples. The experiments demonstrate that the segmentation accuracy of this research method has reached 87.79%, which verifies the effectiveness of the improved algorithm, and the segmentation results can provide favourable data support for the digital conservation of ancient buildings.

articleTitle: A short text topic classification method based on feature expansion and bi-directional neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Short text classification has a pivotal role in many applications such as sentiment analysis and recommender systems. However, the traditional classification models work poorly on short texts due to data sparsity issue. The objective of this research is to determine whether fused topic features will extend short text features and achieve better classification performance. We propose a novel short text topic classification approach and put the topic features into consideration. Firstly, LDA topic model is used to obtain short text topic features. Next, we use BiLSTM(Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory), CNN(Convolutional Neural Networks) and attention mechanism to extended short text feature extraction. Finally, a SoftMax classifier is introduced to obtain the topic classification results of the short texts. Compared with the state-of-the-art short text topic classification approaches, the experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves better performance.

articleTitle: Research on computer vision-based inspection of tiny parts
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: One of the most crucial components of large-scale industrial production and manufacturing is inspection. Inspection can provide trustworthy information on the product's quality and the manufacturing process, and this information can be utilized to better regulate the manufacturing process. Manual measuring with tiny equipment is currently the primary method of inspection. Due to the labor-intensive nature of this method, the subjectivity and unpredictability of human operations may cause variances in the inspection findings. To achieve effective online precision inspection, a thorough examination of the quality inspection system for micro parts is required. The research presented in this paper is a valuable resource for enhancing the precision and effectiveness of quality measurement of minute parts, and it offers fresh perspectives for the creation of non-contact automatic inspection technology for small-sized components.

articleTitle: Multi-influenced Factors Prediction Using a Combination of GEP and PCA-GRNN Model Based on the Shapley Value Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The powerful function mining ability of the gene expression programming algorithm has obvious advantages in predicting dependent variables under multi-influence factors. PCA can obtain the key characteristics of the main influencing factors by the data reduction processing, and the generalized regression neural network can effectively overcome the disadvantage of slow training of the traditional neural network. Taking the cost of civil engineering in subway tunnels as an example, this paper introduces the Shapley value method for a combined prediction based on the prediction results of the above two optimal single prediction models and determines the weight of the two models based on the error of allocation. The results of the study show that the combined prediction model based on the Shapley value method reduces the error better than the single prediction model and further improves the prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: A multi-system collaborative data security and cross-domain authorization mechanism based on domestic cryptographic algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the multi-system collaborative data security and cross-domain authorization mechanism based on domestic cryptographic algorithms. This study is based on domestic cryptographic algorithms, combined with the technical characteristics of asymmetric encryption and symmetric encryption, uses symmetric encryption algorithm to encrypt plaintext data, and encrypts the session key of symmetric encryption using asymmetric encryption algorithm to protect data encryption. The classical data encryption ciphertext structure is optimized and adjusted to achieve the goal of tamper-proof and undeniable data security protection of multi-system collaborative business data.

articleTitle: Design of Launch Vehicle Test Information Management System based on IETM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Traditional launch vehicle tests are recorded on paper, which is not convenient for the effective management of information. In order to improve the informationization level of launch vehicle test management and realize the secure share of integrative test information, a launch vehicle test information management system based on IETM (interactive electronic technology manual) is designed. The overall architecture of the system is constructed, and the working principle of the system is introduced. The crucial technology issues are discussed, such as the reliability design, interface design, secrecy and security design of the system, and the solutions are put forward. The practice demonstrates that the application of the system can improve the information level of the launch vehicle electric test management and the integrative test capability, and the efficiency of searching information is increased by more than quadrupled.

articleTitle: Selection of Prediction Factors of Gross Primary Productivity Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The analysis of drivers of gross primary productivity (GPP) in evergreen coniferous forests is an important part of forest carbon flux research. This study developed an artificial neural network (ANN model for coniferous forest GPP simulation based on the 1941599 half-hourly records of the flux observation network. The correlation coefficient(R) of observed and the predicted values ANN model base on all factors was between 0.89-0.94, and that of the combination of four factors was between 0.89-0.9. The experimental results illustrate that the method can mine the main driving factors for predictive GPP excellently without loss of precision. ANN model base on four factors made a good prediction of GPP. The climatic factors, which were dominantly contributing the prediction of GPP, include net radiation (NETRAD), vapor pressure deficit, air temperature, and soil water content/ carbon dioxide concentration.

articleTitle: Pyramid Structure-Based Context Aggregation Detail Restoration Low-illumination Image Enhancement Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: To address the shortcomings of existing low-illumination image enhancement methods in their ability to perceive and express features at different scales, we propose an image enhancement algorithm based on multi-scale pyramids and structural detail residual fusion blocks. This paper primarily exploits the feature pyramid as the pre-processing module to achieve feature extraction of low-illumination images. Subsequently, we use the backbone network to encode and decode the extracted shallow image features from the three-scale feature pyramid network. We also introduce a structural detail residual fusion block to enhance the network's ability to extract and characterize low-illumination image features. Finally, the extracted feature information is fused layer by layer to recover the normal light image. Experiments conducted on LOL dataset demonstrate that our network architecture achieves superior performance and outperforms the state-of-the-art enhancement approaches in qualitative and quantitative aspects.

articleTitle: Research on communication signal interference suppression based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the development of modern communication technology, people have higher and higher requirements for wireless communication. In practical applications, communication signals are vulnerable to noise and interference signals. Taking effective measures to suppress interference signals can ensure the communication quality. Deep learning technology has strong nonlinear mapping and data expression capabilities, so it can be applied to the field of communication interference suppression. Aiming at the problem that the interference reconstruction algorithm in the traditional interference suppression requires high accuracy of parameter estimation, this paper studies the interference suppression of communication signals combined with the deep learning U-Net network. Through BER simulation analysis, the traditional interference suppression method is compared with the communication signal interference suppression method based on deep learning. The results show that the communication signal interference suppression network based on deep learning can adaptively suppress interference.

articleTitle: Multi-node Monitoring of Jujube Diseases and Pests Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: To promote the scientific management of the jujube industry, achieve pollution-free prevention and control, and meet the higher requirements of data collection of diseases and insect pests, this paper studies the multi-node monitoring of jujube diseases and insect pests based on the Internet of Things technology. In this paper, sensors are selected based on the Internet of Things technology, and different types of equipment are selected for the field monitoring environment to provide data sources for pest analysis. Deployment and coverage nodes are used to divide the deployment coverage areas of ordinary nodes and camera nodes in different ways, and to schedule the direction of sensors. Acquire and process the multi-node monitoring data, and upload the data after fusion processing to the Internet of Things monitoring cloud platform to facilitate real-time identification of jujube diseases and insect pests. The experimental results show that the proposed method has a good monitoring and recognition effect on jujube black spot disease, fruit shrink disease and jujube spider mite, and the accuracy is more than 95%. In this paper, the proportion of disease area in five randomly selected sub-regions was counted, in which the disease area of black spot disease was the largest. The disease area of fruit shrink disease and jujube spider mite was between 20% and 60%. The monitoring results in this paper are consistent with the actual occurrence of diseases, which proves that the method in this paper is feasible, and is conducive to promoting the construction and development of jujube pest and disease monitoring. It also strengthens the application coverage of the Internet of Things in the jujube industry, thus leading the future development direction of the jujube industry.

articleTitle: A Study of User-item Graph Neural Network Recommendation Based on GCCGAT-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: To solve the problem of high root mean square error (RMSE) caused by the Graph Convolution with Graph Attention Network for Matrix Completion (GCGAT), which cannot fully utilize the node's feature information and temporal information. In this paper, we propose an LSTM-based GCGAT algorithm (GCGAT based on LSTM, GCGAT-LSTM) to solve this problem: the linear processing part of the encoder in GCGAT is replaced by long short-term memory algorithm (LSTM). Two LSTM layers are used to process user's and item's feature information separately, named GCGAT -LSTM. This paper conducted several experiments on MovieLens-100K and MovieLens-1M datasets. The experimental results show that GCGAT -LSTM performs better than the GCGAT algorithm, effectively improving the performance of GCGAT and making more accurate recommendations. Compared with the RMSE in the previous GCGAT algorithm, the RMSE of GCGAT-LSTM is reduced by about 0.03 on both datasets. Therefore, the GCGAT-LSTM method proposed in this paper can better use node's feature information and temporal information to make more accurate predictions and thus obtain better recommendation results. However, the GCGAT-LSTM also has some limitations: the LSTM requires sequential processing over time and therefore has low efficiency and high time complexity for the input sequence.

articleTitle: Research on soft start of DFB laser temperature control system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: In order to meet the 6km transmission distance and measurement accuracy of the laser methane sensor in coal mines, natural gas and other industrial and mining environments, firstly, a high-precision double-closed-loop negative feedback temperature control system based on the laser absorption peak and working temperature reduces the control error to about ± 1.37%; based on the integrated TEC temperature control chip to carry out PI compensation network design and system frequency and time domain response characteristics simulation analysis; proposed a temperature control soft-start algorithm based on step-by-step iterative approximation, the transient high current of the methane sensor was reduced to 0.12 A@18VDC, the longest transmission distance is more than 6km; it provides technical support for the comprehensive promotion and application of laser methane sensors in coal mines, natural gas and other industrial and mining fields.

Author Keywords: double closed-loop negative feedback temperature control system

articleTitle: Research on Power Grid Condition Monitoring Method Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the continuous development of social economy, the requirements of the society for the continuity and stability of power grid operation are also constantly improving. As a new type of intelligent power transmission medium, intelligent power grid can effectively improve the monitoring and management effect of power grid and ensure the continuous, safe and stable operation of power network. Under this background, in order to meet the requirements of power grid condition detection and fault analysis, combined with the characteristics of smart grid architecture, this paper will propose a power grid condition monitoring method based on big data analysis technology. This method mainly includes four aspects: data preprocessing, data fusion, data analysis and state visualization, and fault determination and processing. Finally, in order to test the effectiveness of the power grid condition monitoring method, this method is applied to engineering practice, and it is confirmed that the power grid condition monitoring method based on big data can realize the intelligent monitoring of power grid condition and the rapid judgment and treatment of abnormal power grid operation. This can provide support for ensuring the stable operation of smart grid and promoting the intelligent, automatic and information development of power grid.

articleTitle: Automatic control system of wind power generation in mountain area based on Internet of Things technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Wind power generation technology, as one of the methods of utilizing wind energy, has become increasingly mature, and its economic benefits have approached those of conventional energy sources, which has great development potential. The intelligent wind power control system of the Internet of Things is an intelligent wind power control system based on the wind power microcomputer control system, which adopts the Internet of Things technologies such as wireless sensor network, cloud computing, ZigBee network protocol and Tinyos operating system for secondary development. In this system, wireless sensor nodes are deployed on the fan to connect with the sensors inside the fan. The intelligent acquisition module in the node system software collects the running environment and running state data of the fan in real time, and the FUT-STAR cloud computing Internet of Things platform is used to realize system integration and data communication. The “real-time, remote and intelligent” supervision and control of the running state of wind power system can be realized through terminals such as mobile phones or PCs, and the safety and reliability of wind power system operation can be improved.

Author Keywords: Wind power generation in mountainous areas

articleTitle: Network Security Situation Awareness Based on Particle Swarm Optimization of Gated Cycle Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The network security situation awareness method based on particle swarm optimization algorithm is studied in the paper to optimize the gating cycle unit. For the GRU model is easy to fall into local optimum and other shortcomings, the particle swarm algorithm is used to improve it. The differential evolution algorithm is used to improve the particle diversity of the particle swarm algorithm and improve the global optimal solution search ability of the algorithm. The differential evolution improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the weight coefficients of GRU neural network to improve the prediction accuracy of the model. The public data sets are used to verify the proposed model, and the experimental results show that the prediction results of the proposed model have good accuracy and reliable prediction accuracy. Compared with the traditional model and the unoptimized network model, the experimental results show that the prediction accuracy of the proposed model is much higher than that of other models, which further illustrates the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Multivariate time series prediction based on graph convolutional neural networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The advent of the big data era has led to the explosive growth of multivariate and multi-channel time series data. Multivariate time series, because of their high dimensional and Spatio-temporal correlation characteristics, make it difficult for classical statistical approaches to effectively model and efficiently handle the Spatio-temporal characteristics among data. Therefore, a multivariate time series prediction model based on a graph convolutional neural network is proposed better to explore the spatial relationships between multivariate time series and predict multivariate time series more accurately. The spatial correlation between each monitoring point in the data monitoring system is extracted using the graph convolutional neural network, and the temporal features in the sequences are processed using GRU. Finally, it is normalized. Experiments prove that the GCN-GRU model has higher prediction accuracy and better results than other commonly used prediction methods.

articleTitle: Improvement of Energy Detection with Cooperative Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: In today's society, the demand for wireless spectrum resources is increasing. Under the framework of existing spectrum management, the available spectrum resources are becoming increasingly scarce. Spectrum sensing is the key technology to realize cognitive radio technology, which can sense the spectrum hole in the channel, so those cognitive users can use the spectrum hole to transmit information; thus, alleviating the contradiction between spectrum resource shortage and communication service demand. In this paper, we use a common method of spectrum sensing - energy detection method, to calculate the perception time in a fixed scene. This paper shows how to use Matlab to do this simulation and find the best result.

articleTitle: TDOA/FDOA Joint Positioning Method for Wireless Charging Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The batteries of transmission line patrol inspection equipment are powered online by wireless charging vehicle. It is particularly important to plan the charging path of the charging vehicle reasonably for energy conservation, and precise positioning is the premise of path planning. In order to solve the problem of high-precision three-dimensional positioning of wireless charging vehicles for power mobile inspection equipment, this paper proposes a TDOA/FDOA joint positioning method based on the two-step weighted least squares method. The first step is to roughly estimate the position and speed of the target, and the second step is to construct the error vector for error compensation, and finally realize the position and speed estimation of the wireless charging vehicle. Simulation results show that the position and speed estimation of the observed target are almost unaffected by the position change when the noise variance is less than 0dB, and the RMSE error of the proposed algorithm is approximately equal to the Cramer-rao lower bound.

articleTitle: Research on Fatigue Assessment Algorithm based on ECG and Multi-source Physiological Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The transmission line maintenance operation environment is harsh, and if the operators suffer from relevant diseases or poor physical and mental status, they are highly vulnerable to danger. Currently, there is a lack of monitoring equipment and fatigue state assessment methods, and the supervisors cannot grasp the fatigue status of the operators. Therefore, this paper designs a multi-source physiological signal measurement circuit, collects physiological signal data of 10 operators under simulated operational load, extracts the nonlinear characteristics of ECG signals, and constructs a fatigue assessment sample library by combining body temperature and blood oxygen data. Subsequently, this paper designed a fatigue assessment algorithm based on deep recurrent network, trained and tested the algorithm using the fatigue assessment sample library, and achieved an assessment accuracy of 95.6%.

articleTitle: Research on Modulation Strategy of T-type Three-level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Inverter is indispensable in photovoltaic power generation, and T-type three-level inverter has become a research hotspot because of its high conversion efficiency, but there are problems such as high mode voltage and midpoint potential imbalance when connected to the grid, in order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved modulation strategy. The basic vector with a small common-mode voltage value is selected to suppress the common-mode voltage from the root, and a regulation factor is introduced to adjust when the potential is unbalanced. This method realizes the midpoint potential balance while rejecting the common-mode voltage, and the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by simulation and experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Garbage Classification Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the information age, the application of artificial intelligence has gradually expanded to various fields, including image and video identification, speech recognition, fingerprint recognition, face recognition, UAV, robot, weather forecast, etc. Deep learning is a very active direction in the field of artificial intelligence. Recently, the state has introduced policies on promoting the classification of domestic waste, and vigorously advocates the classification of waste, while the traditional disposal method wastes manpower, material resources and time. Therefore, this paper mainly introduces the development of deep learning and the application of Python in deep learning, as well as the study of intelligent garbage classification algorithm based on Python deep learning.

articleTitle: Application of Internet of things in data aggregation system of electric power construction equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IOT) is a complex application of a variety of technologies. Communicate and exchange information in a mutually agreed manner by identifying radio frequencies, global positioning, use of measurement data, and other items. In order to implement the strategic goal of “three types of two networks and world-class”, the design of the technical architecture of the intelligent IOT data aggregation Center for electrical equipment based on micro services is proposed. This article studies and applies microservices and container technologies, designs the technical architecture of the intelligent IOT data aggregation Center for electrical equipment based on microservices, and solves the problems of collaborative development and deployment of distributed and heterogeneous environments in state grid companies. Through the development and application of the intelligent IOT data aggregation Center for electrical equipment, the IOT data and business data of various categories are transmitted, aggregated, interacted and stored, and the data are mined, analyzed and applied, which strongly supports the application of material companies in bidding procurement, quality supervision, capacity evaluation and fault analysis, and achieves the effect of reducing costs and increasing efficiency, and improving quality and management level.

articleTitle: An Optimizing E-govenment Model for Data Sharing via Distributed Ledgers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the development of terminal technology and the expansion of application areas, the value of e-government applications and service requirements continue to increase. To develop and apply e-government, data sharing efficiency is essential. Using the e-government data sharing as a research object, a blockchain-based method is developed for optimizing data transfer. Blockchain technology is used for storing and delivering distributed data. Rather than distributing data nodes randomly, our network scenario model employs a matrix lattice model based on a complete undirected graph. Dual optimization is then applied to solve the problem. In order to find the optimal solution, a mathematical model and an artificial neural network are developed. To verify the performance and packet loss rate of the government data transmission method, a case study is conducted. Data Sharing is optimized to increase the lifetime of static aggregation nodes by at least 30% and lifetime of static aggregation nodes by at least 20%. The network lifetime can be extended by optimizing static aggregation nodes. Furthermore,it effectively improves the robustness.

articleTitle: Flight cockpit gesture recognition based on YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the rise of smart mobile devices and wearable devices, emerging technologies such as gesture recognition have been widely used in reality. However, its application for specific complex scenarios (such as flight cockpit gesture recognition) is not perfect at present. In view of this, in this paper, a flight cockpit gesture simulation dataset (FCGS) is firstly proposed; secondly, a flight cockpit gesture recognition algorithm YOLOv7H is proposed, which is based on the YOLOv7 algorithm Reconstruction on the basis of: The BackBone part adopts the Hornet series network, which effectively combines the advantages of the visual Transformer and CNN, and adds a No-parameter attention mechanism (SimAM) module to the Head network, which improves the representation ability of the convolutional network, with flexibility and effectiveness. The results obtained in this experiment are: percison increased from 92.469% of YOLOv7 to 98.053%, recall increased from 97.486<sup>%</sup> of YOLOv7 to 99.994%, and mAP increased from 99.448% of YOLOv7 to 99.500%. In the scene of flight cockpit gesture recognition, the recognition accuracy of YOLOv7H is better than the current mainstream target detection algorithm, and the recognition speed is almost the same. It has advantages in processing natural interactive information and provides an effective means for human-computer interaction. In addition, The source code will be published in https://github.com/Dennis-Chen2021/aircraft-cockpit-gesture-recognition.

articleTitle: An Improved Simulation Model of Duffing Oscillator with Lyapunov Characteristic Exponents
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: This paper presents an improved new simulation model of the Duffing oscillator using Matlab. At first the state equations of Duffing oscillator and the equations of Lyapunov characteristic exponents obtained by RHR algorithm is put together as a unified state equation group. Based on it a unified simulation model is established. This model can not only show the phase trajectory and timing diagrams of Duffing oscillator, but also show the curves of Lyapunov characteristic exponents changing with time. The dynamic behavior is analyzed by the simulation model. A state double discrimination method based on Lyapunov characteristic exponents and phase diagram has been established.

articleTitle: Research on “scenario assessment+” action mode applied in agile talent training with k-prototype algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: This paper sets up the research progress on “scenario assessment+” action mode on agile talent training with k-prototype algorithm. With context integration and massive data information technology, the graph analysis technology is adopted to evaluate agile talent training of the power system by integrating the developed scenarios with the working scenarios, and a new model of “scenario assessment” + action mode + potential mining is explored, which not only solves market customers and multi-domain collaborative innovation breakthroughs, but also provides a new paradigm for high potential talents of enterprises.

articleTitle: Design of EMG and FMG multi-sensing acquisition system for lip muscle training
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Lip training is an essential part of orthodontic treatment. The effectiveness of lip training can be more fully assessed by providing information on surface electromyography and inter-lip pressure. However, a solution for simultaneous collection of surface electromyography and Force myography during Lip training is still lacking. In this paper, we propose a multi-sensing acquisition system for lip training using surface electromyography and Force myography. The system consists of a flexible electrode, a pressure sensor, and a signal acquisition module. The system's flexible electrodes combined with pressure sensors can collect surface electromyography and inter-lip Force myography signals on the lip's narrow and curved skin surface. The acquisition module implements signal conditioning, analog-to-digital conversion, and wireless transmission of both signals. The experimental results show that the common mode rejection ratio of the surface electromyography acquisition circuit is greater than 110dB, the noise level is lower than 4.3 μV, and the sampling frequency is 1000Hz. The Force myography signal acquisition circuit has a sensitivity of 0.22 V /N and excellent linearity. The whole system satisfies surface electromyography and pressure signal detection under lip training.

articleTitle: Equipment selection method and application of power grid infrastructure project based on particle swarm algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the acceleration of power grid construction, the assets of power grid equipment are increasing. There are many kinds and large quantities of power grid equipment, and their operation conditions vary greatly. Based on particle swarm optimization with passive aggregation (PSOPC) algorithm and harmony search (HS) algorithm, a new hybrid particle swarm optimization (HPSO) algorithm is constructed. According to the characteristics of power grid planning, the algorithm uses “fly back mechanism” to deal with the constraints of variables, and uses harmonious search to deal with the constraints of planning problems, so that particle swarm always stays within the feasible region during the iteration process. At the same time, the algorithm introduces passive aggregation factor, which effectively improves the evolution mechanism of particles and improves the free search ability of particles. In order to obtain more accurate prediction results, a combination algorithm based on improved particle swarm optimization is adopted to optimize and combine the prediction results of the three methods to obtain the final prediction value.

articleTitle: Beamforming of Frustum of a cone Conformal Array Based on Convex Optimization Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The conformal array antenna can keep the same shape as the carrier surface, which in turn can reduce the radar scattering cross-sectional area (RCS). In addition, it can expand the scanning range and improve space utilization, which has a broad application prospect. Beam formation is one of the important research directions of array antennas, which can achieve high gain, low sub flap, and even specific zero-trapped directional maps with practical applications. However, the traditional beamforming algorithm applied to the conformal array for beam optimization has the problem of high side flaps. In this paper, the baffle model is established mainly using the directed array elements, and the convex optimization theory is used to achieve a two-dimensional beam with low partials and zero-trapping formation in the direction of interference under specific main flap constraints.

articleTitle: 2.4GHz wide band high efficiency rectenna with three sector branches
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the rise of microwave wireless energy transmission technology, rectenna for energy harvesting is becoming a new technology. Rectenna is composed of a receiving antenna and a rectifying circuit. However, the traditional rectenna has some disadvantages such as low conversion efficiency and weak harmonic suppression ability. Therefore, in this paper, the receiver antenna and pass-through filter are improved reasonably, and a rectenna which can be applied to ISM frequency band is designed. The receiving antenna part consists of a CPW-fed 2.4GHz broadband hexagonal omnidirectional antenna with a bandwidth of 66%, S<inf>11</inf> of about - 30dB, and gain of about 2.55dBi. The rectifier circuit part is a high efficiency rectifier circuit with three sector branch structure. The measured data show that the efficiency of the rectifier circuit is 62% and the output voltage is 5.1V. Thus, the rectenna can be used to power low-power sensors and other devices.

articleTitle: The development of the portable leakage detector data acquisition device
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: This paper introduces the portable leakage detector data acquisition device based on DSPIC33F single-chip microcomputer, by dipole device to collect effective ground potential difference signal, the signal conditioning circuit high-speed A/D conversion, by single chip microcomputer to calculate the acquisition of data, the measurement results will be displayed on the LCD screen, according the results to judge the leakage location by the artificial way. And the calculated data by single chip microcomputer and sampling time store in the external RAM according to the unit, for completion of a certain region, the collection of data by USB transfer principal computer, based on the processing of historical data, draw the electric potential distribution area detection, pinpoint the location of the leakage point, avoid false negatives. The device is controlled by the virtual instrument platform LabView program to flexibly realize different experimental schemes. The method of the device is verified by theoretical model and field example, and compared with model built by res3dmod. The results show that the convenient detection device can well reflect the abnormal point situation of the landfill.

articleTitle: Error Correction of Modulation Transfer Function in High Resolution Imaging System by Improved Slanted- Edge Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: An improved method based on the inclined edge method is proposed to measure the modulation transfer function of the photoelectric imaging system. An improved Canny operator that automatically determines the high and low threshold is used to extract the edge position points, and the edge inclination is obtained by linear fitting the extracted edge position points. In the process of fitting the edge diffusion function with Fermi function, robust estimation is used to replace the least square estimation, which optimizes the process of edge line fitting and ESF fitting in the traditional inclined edge method, The accuracy of edge line fitting and MTF reconstruction of the inclined edge method are evaluated and analyzed by simulation. The experimental results show that the slanted edge method based on robust estimation can effectively suppress the influence of noise, and the edge line fitting results and MTF reconstruction results are in good agreement with the true values, with strong stability.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Power Engineering Material Online Management Platform Based on the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: In order to strengthen the quality and efficiency of power engineering materials management and realize the intelligence and informatization of power materials management. In this paper, aiming at the low accuracy of reading data of power engineering materials, the design and research of an online management platform of power engineering materials based on the Internet of Things are completed. The SP3232 chip is designed in hardware. In the aspect of the software, the software architecture of the online management platform for power engineering materials is constructed, and the software part of the platform is controlled as a whole. By using the Internet of Things, the data reading algorithm for the power engineering materials is designed to improve the accuracy of material data reading, thus realizing the efficient management of power engineering materials. The platform test results show that the platform has higher data reading accuracy and a better material management level, which is of great promotional value.

articleTitle: University Intelligent Teaching Information Processing Management Platform Based on Resource Clustering Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: To improve the intelligent level of teaching management in colleges and universities, a research on intelligent teaching management platform in colleges and universities based on resource clustering is proposed. On the hardware, this paper implements the platform operation through the user layer, presentation layer, business logic layer and persistence layer. In software design, the classification and storage of teaching resources are completed based on resource clustering algorithm, and the sharing and storage management of data are realized. The functional structure of students and teachers' client is designed based on Web environment, which provides students and teachers with student management services and educational administration function interface services. It also establishes the teaching management service function module to complete the teaching management design of each dimension of the platform for colleges and universities. Through the analysis of experimental demonstration, the functional modules of this platform can correctly handle the process of teaching management affairs. Under the condition of different number of concurrent users, the delay time of this platform is less than 3s, which can provide good performance support and prove the reliability of this platform. This platform can effectively overcome the phenomenon of repeated management in colleges and universities, improve the utilization of teaching resources, and contribute to the intelligent teaching management services in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Visibility Analysis in Fog Weather Based on Convolution Neural Network and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: In this paper, a deep learning model based on convolutional neural network and transfer learning is adopted to realize the recognition and estimation of airport video images, and to evaluate the accuracy of the estimated visibility. In order to highlight the advantages of the transfer learning method, we have established a deep learning model and a machine learning model respectively. In the traditional image recognition method, 11-dimensional information features of the image are recognized, and BP neural network model and evaluation accuracy are established; On the deep learning model, we first match the airport video with the visibility data, and determine the parameters through the pretraining model. Then we randomly divide the image and data into training sets and testing sets at a ratio of 7:3. Fix the pre network parameter training and adjust the deep learning model. After 100 iterations, the accuracy of the training set and test set respectively reached 80.48% and 79.63%. The results show that the deep learning model based on convolutional neural network and transfer learning does have higher efficiency and recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: ECIP: An Edge Cloud Intelligent Platform for Radio Access Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: An edge cloud intelligent platform (ECIP) which integrates Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) and RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) platform is proposed in this paper, it takes advantage of edge cloud computing capacity and the ability of intelligent optimization on radio access network to support KPI awareness service for SLA assurance. The functional and software architectures of the ECIP is introduced in this paper with emphasis on machine learning mechanism. Furthermore, QoE management use case is demonstrated on ECIP to show the collaborative working process between application and different platform services and the result validates the solution's feasibility and advancement.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Intelligent Protection Capabilities Against Internet Routing Hijacking and Leakage
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the rapid growth of the number of global network entities and interconnections, the security risks of network relationships are constantly accumulating. As the basis of network interconnection and communication, Internet routing is facing severe challenges such as insufficient online monitoring capability of large-scale routing events and lack of effective and credible verification mechanism. Major global routing security events emerge one after another, causing extensive and far-reaching impacts. To solve these problems, China Telecom studied the BGP (border gateway protocol) SDN (software defined network) controller technology to monitor the interconnection routing, constructed the global routing information database trust source integrating multi-dimensional information and developed the function of the protocol level based real-time monitoring system of Internet routing security events. Through these means, it realizes the second-level online monitoring capability of large-scale IP network Internet service routing events, forms the minute-level route leakage interception and route hijacking blocking solutions, and achieves intelligent protection capability of Internet routing security.

articleTitle: Necessity of Regional Coordinated Development of New Energy Vehicles Based On System Dynamics Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: This paper constructs a system dynamics simulation model, which is divided into five subsystems of economy, population, energy, environment and government. The empirical results of the model show that considering the spatial spillover effect, the energy subsystem and other modules in the system will have a phenomenon of offsetting the effect of policy implementation. Therefore, in the future, attention should be paid to the regional coordinated development of new energy vehicles. Joint implementation of policies within the region will be more conducive to the promotion of new energy vehicles and the alleviation of environmental pressure.

articleTitle: Target Tracking Algorithm of Radar and Infrared Sensor Based on Multi-Source Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Nowadays, with the extensive application of interference technology, the accuracy and stability of target tracking system are facing severe challenges. In order to improve the tracking accuracy and anti-interference ability of UAV to ship targets, a multi-mode compound tracking algorithm based on multi-source information fusion is proposed. Firstly, the local estimation of radar and infrared sensor is given based on the interacting multi model unscented Kalman filter (IMM-UKF) algorithm. On this basis, the interference detection module is introduced to identify and reconstruct the interfered track. Finally, the global estimation of the track is given based on the hierarchical track fusion algorithm. The simulation results show that the algorithm can not only improve the target tracking accuracy, but also effectively improve the anti-interference ability and stability of the tracking system.

articleTitle: Research on infrared detection and intelligent identification technology of oil and gas pipeline leakage
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: To address the actual problem of oil and gas pipeline leaks, this paper designs an experimental device to simulate the leak state by controlling the water flow rate of the tap, selects the infrared detection method to collect the images of the leak state using an infrared thermal imager, and then detects the leaks based on deep learning and AlexNet network for intelligent recognition of the images. The detection of oil and gas pipeline leaks is very important for oil and gas transportation, and effective detection can reduce leaks and the occurrence of accidents.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of human-machine model dynamics based onADAMS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the general upward trend in the incidence of stroke in the population, the use of rehabilitation robots to replace traditional rehabilitation methods is a work that has both important practical significance and research difficulty. The theoretical basis of the human-computer interaction of the rehabilitation robot is an important part of the research and development process of the rehabilitation robot. In order to investigate the dynamics of the human-machine co-integrated system with the two-degree-of-freedom lower limb rehabilitation robot, the walking dynamics simulation of the human-machine model under three weight reduction modes (30%, 50% and 70%) was established in ADAMS. The torque curves of hip and knee joints and foot-ground contact force curves during human-robot walking were obtained. The relationship between the various curves and human gait was analyzed to verify the validity of the kinetic model. This paper provides a theoretical basis for the construction of the control system and the selection of the interaction strategy.

articleTitle: Game Storyboard Script: A Fast Camera Placement Tool for Cinematographic Information Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Interactive narrative game is an important gene of digital games. To design an interactive narrative game, the placement of camera is essential to convey the narrative. There are two issues for placing camera. Firstly, the parameters of camera has no direct semantic relation to the staging performance. Secondly, some cameras share the same pattern but differ in parameters which results in a huge amount of repetitive work for designers. In this paper, we develop a tool call game storyboard language (GSS) to allow designer depicting the storyboard of the shot rather than directly place the camera in the virtual scene. We make an experiment to compare the result generated by GSS engine and those manual shots gathered in The Witcher 3. Our results given by the engine show the same effect as the manual shots while the configuration process is simpler.

articleTitle: A Data Analysis Method of Military Training Performance Based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The military training performance data is the important embodiment of the military academy cadets' academic achievement, and is the first-hand data to test the military academy's teaching effect. It is of great significance to analyze the performance data for improving the training level of military academy personnel.
