In view of the shortcomings of traditional training data analysis method which is difficult to excavate deep-level information, this paper proposes a method of performance data analysis based on Apriori correlation algorithm, and makes an application case analysis with the result data of trainees' graduation exercises as an example. The experimental results show that the method can be used to analyze the military training performance data efficiently, and the results can provide scientific reference for the teaching work in Military academy.

articleTitle: Underwater salient object detection based on frequency-tuned
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Under the environment of ocean development, underwater object detection technology has been widely used. Underwater salient object detection technology plays an important role in this process. The complex optical environment of underwater makes the underwater optical image have low contrast, colour distortion and blurred boundary, which causes great interference to the underwater visual salient object detection. Searching for saliency features of images from a frequency domain perspective is an effective means. In this paper, the frequency-tuned salient object detection method is used. After comparison with the images in the atmosphere, it is not significantly reduced in the indicators, which can obviously meet certain detection requirements.

articleTitle: Classification algorithm of streaming media big data fusion under multi-task information filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: In order to improve the recognition ability of streaming media big data on the communication platform of information fusion terminal, a streaming media big data fusion algorithm based on multi-task information filtering is proposed. This paper analyzes the storage structure model of streaming media big data of information fusion terminal communication platform, uses association matching filtering fusion detection method to cluster the fusion of streaming media big data of information fusion terminal communication platform, mines fuzzy correlation feature quantity of streaming media big data of information fusion terminal communication platform, and uses support vector machine learning model to classify features of streaming media big data of information fusion terminal communication platform. According to the classification attribute of streaming media big data of information fusion terminal communication platform, multi-task information screening and fusion clustering processing are carried out, and the feature reconstruction and optimized clustering of streaming media big data of information fusion terminal communication platform are realized by using statistical sequence analysis method. The simulation results show that this method has good adaptability in streaming media big data clustering on the communication platform of information fusion terminal, and the recognition degree of big data fusion is high and the error rate is low.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of LSTM Model Based on Electrical Equipment in Electromagnetic Field Calculation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Since the 21st century, the development of information technology and artificial intelligence has reached new heights, and the intelligent manufacture of electrical equipment has become the main development goal of industrial manufacturing in China. The core part of intelligent manufacturing of electrical equipment is the use of data to build mathematical models for real-time analysis, but for large volume and complex structure of electrical equipment, the traditional finite element analysis method will involve large-scale numerical calculations, resulting in slow calculation speed, accuracy is difficult to meet the design requirements, cannot meet the real-time requirements. This paper applies deep learning theory to the electromagnetic field analysis of electric motors, using the electromagnetic field distribution data corresponding to different motor structures to train the built deep learning model to predict the electromagnetic field distribution instead of the traditional finite element calculation, improving research efficiency, reducing time costs and meeting the requirements of intelligent manufacturing for real-time. In this paper, the predicted electromagnetic field distribution is compared with the MSE and MAE of the training set and test set respectively, then the electromagnetic field distribution data is plotted as a line graph to observe the error between the true and predicted values, and finally the predicted electromagnetic field distribution data is visualised as a magnetic line graph using simulation software, and compared with the magnetic line graph obtained from ANSYS Maxwell simulation, and the data of some random points are taken for comparison.

articleTitle: A Novel End-to-End Object Detection Model Based on Multi-scale Deformable Attention Module
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Although Transformer has good performance in NLP, but it is introduced into the CV, when the processing object is an image, due to its own characteristics resulting in computational complexity and spatial complexity is very large, forcing the model to use only low-resolution image features, the present invention for the PIX2SEQ model is still used in this way, by introducing a deformable attention mechanism into the transformer, greatly reducing its complexity, This enables the model to use high-resolution image features and multi-scale feature information, thereby improving the model detection performance.

articleTitle: Prediction of regional ecological security by applying deep learning methods in spatial and temporal simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Climate change is becoming the most important ecological and environmental issue on a global scale. Regional ecological security simulation and prediction based on computer deep learning is a way to use advanced technology to help human work and protect our ecological security issues. Computer deep learning can help regional ecological security research to achieve simulation and prediction in the areas of integrated water security, biosafety, address disaster security, cultural heritage security and recreational safety. In the specific implementation, we use the genetic algorithm that has been proved to be the most stable in practice, and through the evolution and analysis, the optimization of time-space simulation and prediction is continuously carried out. It is hoped that through the research of this paper, it has certain reference significance for the protection of regional ecological security.

articleTitle: Fault segment location method based on CEEDMAN-Energy Relative entropy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of fault location in small current ground system, this paper proposes a fault segment location method based on CEEDMAN-energy relative entropy. Firstly, the IMF components of local characteristics of several reaction signals were obtained by CEEDMAN (Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise) decomposition of fault zero-sequence current, and the main frequency components of zero-sequence current were determined by comparing the energy boundary spectra of each IMF component. According to the upstream and downstream characteristics of the fault point, this paper combines the energy relative entropy to measure the difference degree of transient components between adjacent monitoring points, and selects the section with the maximum energy relative entropy as the fault section. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed method is significantly improved compared with the traditional positioning method, and is not affected by the fault initial phase Angle, transition resistance and other factors, and the fault location accuracy is high.

articleTitle: Research on Signal Integrity Technology of Missile borne Integrated Control Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: At present, missiles are developing towards integration, miniaturization and modularization, The overall requirements for the missile borne integrated control unit are also changing towards low cost, low power consumption and scalability, Traditional discrete devices can no longer meet the current form of development, Currently, highly integrated, scalable, high frequency, low power processors are used in the missile borne integrated control unit, At the same time of reducing cost and volume, signal integrity problems also arise. Signal integrity mainly includes reflection of single signal line, Crosstalk between two signal lines, Collapse of power rail, Electromagnetic interference, etc

articleTitle: A two-stream attention mechanisms network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: In the field of neurology, the concept of attention mechanism is frequently applied to neural networks. Focusing on the application of attention mechanisms in feature map channels and spatial, we propose a two-stream attention networks (called TSAN) based on channel and spatial that can be applied to neural networks. The TSAN network consists of two consecutive parts. The input feature map is first passed through the channel submodule and then through the space sub-module to obtain a feature layer with attention weights. The channel sub-module compresses channel information by using global maximum pooling. The channel sub-module compresses each input feature map into a learnable weight to represent the features of the feature map. The spatial sub-module also uses the global maximum pooling layer to aggregate the location information of the feature maps along the channel axes. By performing spatial compression along the channel axis, the spatial sub-module can generate a corresponding learnable weight for each spatial location. Meanwhile, to further capture the spatial location dependence over long distances, the spatial sub-module will receive inputs from two consecutive feature maps. Since TSAN is a tiny universal block, it can be seamlessly inserted into any CNN architecture with negligible overhead. Also, TSAN can be trained together with the underlying CNN. We validate the neural network with TSAN by conducting extensive experiments using ImageNet, CIFAR-100 datasets. Our experiments show that TSAN can improve the robustness and accuracy of various models for image classification and object detection, which demonstrates the wide applicability of TSAN.

articleTitle: Fault Simulation of A320 Aircraft Generator Based on Directed Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Generator is an important part of aircraft main power supply, which is responsible for providing power for radar, lighting and other airborne equipment on the aircraft. If any link of the generator fails, it will not only affect its normal operation, but also may cause the aircraft to be unable to fly normally, and even cause serious aviation accidents. Therefore, it has important practical significance and huge economic benefits to carry out in-depth research on fault simulation technology of generator. In this paper, the A320 aircraft generator is taken as the research object, the generator function model is established by using the directed graph method, and the power system AC path simulation model is built on the MATLAB/SIMULINK platform. The simulation results show that the model can easily and effectively simulate the working state of the power system AC path after the generator failure.

articleTitle: Micro-grid Power Conversion Control Method Based on Single-phase Isolated Energy Storage Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Energy storage converter is the key equipment for energy storage control in micro-grid, uninterruptible power supply (UPS) and other devices. In the conventional micro-grid power conversion control method, the energy storage unit is controlled dispersedly depending on the fluctuation characteristics of the micro-grid, so that the micro-grid power conversion process is delayed. The synchronous power conversion cannot be achieved. Therefore, a power conversion control method of micro-grid based on single-phase isolated energy storage converter is designed. Then, And determine that charging control parameter of the energy storage converter of the micro-grid to obtain the maximum charging current. Then the single-phase energy storage converter is used to control the synchronous conversion of charging and discharging power. The harmonic current is compensated on the basis of power outer ring control, thus realizing the effective control of micro-grid power conversion. The simulation results indicate that the control error of this control method is smaller, and it can be applied to real life.

articleTitle: GPU Acceleration of Monte Carlo Tree Search Algorithm for Amazon chess and Its Evaluation Function
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The evaluation function is a very important part of the Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) algorithm for Amazon chess. This paper introduces the principle of Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithm, and realizes GPU accelerated calculation of Amazon chess situation's evaluation function, based on CUDA computing platform. Using the CPU code and CUDA code, two experiments were carried out to evaluate the function calculation accuracy and the effect of kernel function call parameters on the GPU acceleration performance. The results show that the evaluation function is feasible and effective for GPU acceleration, and the speedup ratio of GPU to CPU reaches 20.0.

articleTitle: IPM Modeling Approach for Dynamic Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: In this paper a dynamic electric model for system-level design and simulation of the high voltage hybrid integrated intelligent power module (IPM) is developed. Three-dimensional physical layout structure of the IPM is modeled with accurate geometry parameters, where current conduction paths and source/sink reference currents are defined. From the physical layout, the frequency-dependent parasitic resistances and partial inductances along the current conduction paths are extracted. In addition, the more accurate parameterized power device models are created based on datasheet and measurement data to match both the static, dynamic and thermal characteristics. Then, the extracted parasitic parameters are used in conjunction with the power device models to create an electric model of the IPM for the system-level dynamic simulation. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by comparing the simulated results with experimental results.

articleTitle: Research on Cost Risk Assessment Method of Power Grid Engineering Based on LEC Method and Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the full implementation and promotion of the “new power reform”, the requirements of power grid enterprises to strengthen lean management are getting higher and higher. With the full implementation of the “new electricity” and advance, power grid enterprises to strengthen the lean management requirements are higher and higher, therefore, scientific and reasonable to carry out power grid engineering cost risk evaluation, to avoid foreseeable risk, at the same time improve the prevention and control ability of some potential risks, so as to improve the level of power grid enterprise risk control and cost control level. Based on the systematic combing and analysis of the power grid engineering cost risk points, this paper puts forward the power grid engineering cost risk assessment method based on the LEC method and the fuzzy theory.

articleTitle: Research on Cascade Power Dispatching Based on artificial intelligence learning model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the vigorous development of market economy and the deepening of power system reform in China, power dispatching is not only responsible for maintaining the stability of power grid system, but also increases the requirements of market operation, economic dispatching and other related work. In the above context, this paper mainly takes Waterfall Valley, Deep Creek Valley and Pillow Head Dam hydropower station in Dadu River Basin as examples to build artificial intelligence learning model and carry out load distribution strategy research of three-station combined economic dispatching control (EDC).

articleTitle: Robust control of temperature parameters for high-precision calibration
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: This paper builds a simplified nonlinear model of the refrigeration system for the temperature control for the calibration process. A nonlinear disturbance observer is designed to estimate the disturbance value, and a virtual control variable is used for feedforward compensation of the unmatched disturbance. Comparison result with the integral nonlinearity method demonstrates the superior capability of the proposed method on disturbance rejection, which can effectively ensure the stability of temperature parameters during instrument calibration.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection based on Teacher-Student Network in the field of Security Document Production
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Our paper proposes an unsupervised learning framework for knowledge distillation based on teacher-student networks for anomaly detection and classification in secure document images. The teacher network uses Wide-ResNet-50 as the backbone network and is pre-trained on large datasets of secure document images and ImageNet. We use a multi-scale feature pyramid matching strategy, so that the student network can receive multi-scale feature maps to better detect anomalies of various sizes. We introduce an attention mechanism to transfer the attention map of the middle layer of the teacher model to the student model as knowledge, hoping that the student model will focus on the region that the teacher model focuses on, thereby distinguishing the difference between normal regions and abnormal regions, and improving the accuracy of detecting anomalies. Our method is applied in the field of Security document to achieve accurate and fast anomaly detection.

articleTitle: Analysing Management Data through Cascade Additive Noise Models from Shanghai Scenario
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Causal discovery has attracted considerable attention, both scholarly and popular. Among various methods, Cascade Additive Noise Models has been proved to be a robust one as some successful test about real world dataset achieved, like electricity consumption and stock market. In management scenarios, previous research has indicated potential associations between Organizational Citizenship Behavior and Intrinsic Motivation. However, managerial researchers have not treated the causal effect among these behaviors and psychological elements. The present study aims to explore the application of Cascade Additive Noise Models in organizational behavior dataset. The findings show that firstly Cascade Additive Noise Model can be applied as an instrument for analyzing the causal direction of a specific management issue. Secondly, this model can be a developmental gateway besides the traditional statistical investigation. An essential implication of this work could be the possibility that utilizes this model into a broader range for the purpose not only cross-checking but also interweaving.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Intelligent Internet of Things Architecture Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low similarity between virtual nodes and physical objects due to the weak design of virtual nodes in the current smart Internet of Things architecture design method, a smart Internet of Things architecture design method based on digital twins is proposed. The Internet of Things system constructs a five-dimensional model of digital twins, processes physical entities with digital twins, and obtains virtual node data. Using wireless communication technology or remote communication technology, the entity data of the Internet of Things is transmitted to the digital twin to optimize the architecture of the Internet of Things. The ISO/1RC18000 is selected as the communication protocol of the intelligent Internet of Things system to realize the data transmission of the virtual node. An application test link is constructed to test the method. The test results show that this method can effectively improve the similarity between virtual nodes and physical objects and the construction speed of virtual nodes, and can improve the operation quality of the intelligent Internet of Things system.

articleTitle: Task and State Oriented Optimization of Helicopter Air-to-Ground Communication Network Reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: At present, many communication systems, such as shortwave, ultrashort wave, microwave and satellite, have been widely used in civilian helicopters. However, how to choose the optimal network for communication, optimize the communication quality and improve the network service quality according to the current network performance and service requirements is of great significance to improve the helicopter communication support capability. Aiming at the need of multi-objective reconfiguration and optimal utilization of communication network resources, this paper studies the reconfiguration strategy of helicopter air-to-air communication network, and proposes a platform end reconfiguration method and network selection method aiming at the optimal end-to-end service efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on IETM Data Publishing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: China released the interactive electronic technical manual (IETM) and the national military standard GJB6600, in 2010. The standard provides a good guide and specification for the use of military equipment technical data. To facilitate the efficient use of equipment technical data knowledge, it is necessary to store the technical data in a modular and standardized way to realize the interactive access and query of equipment technical data. Since other articles have introduced the interactive editing and modular standardized storage of equipment technical data, according to the requirements of interactive access and retrieval of equipment technical manual data, this paper designs an interactive electronic technical manual publishing engine to realize the organization and release of equipment technical data and form a manual data package supporting interactive access and retrieval. Firstly, this paper analyzes the basis of IETM data publishing requirements. On this basis, the IETM data release process is designed. The principle of IETM data release and its software function are analyzed. Finally, the IETM data publishing engine is implemented using J2EE technology and applied to a variety of products.

articleTitle: Recognition of Junk Short Messages Based on Local Sensitive Hash KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: At present, the recognition and filtering of spam short messages mainly include the following technologies: black and white list recognition technology, transmission frequency limit recognition technology, keyword matching recognition technology, and machine learning based spam short message recognition technology. These commonly used spam short message recognition technologies have their own limitations. The K-Nearest Neighbor algorithm (KNN, K-Nearest Neighbor) based on locally sensitive hashing proposed in this paper can find the samples as close as possible when the eigenvectors are similar but not identical. First, define the features, and then use the local sensitive hash method(LSH). The task of calculating the similarity of the matrix is to find a measure, quantify the similarity of the matrix, compile and train the model, generate the matrix based on the text content of the short message, use TF-IDF algorithm, use Local Sensitive Hash to solve the most similar samples, record the category of the samples, import the training results to the KNN classifier, and obtain the best nearest neighbor through continuous experiments. The accuracy rate is evaluated on the test set or verification set. After KNN classifier, the classification accuracy rate reaches 98.7%.

articleTitle: Research on network security behavior audit method of power industrial control system operation support cloud platform based on FP-Growth association rule algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the introduction of the national “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality” strategic goals and the accelerated construction of the new generation of power systems, cloud applications built on advanced IT technologies play an increasingly important role in meeting the needs of digital power business. In view of the characteristics of the current power industrial control system operation support cloud platform with wide coverage, large amount of log data, and low analysis intelligence, this paper proposes a cloud platform network security behavior audit method based on FP-Growth association rule algorithm, aiming at the uniqueness of the operating data of the cloud platform that directly interacts with the isolated system environment of power industrial control system. By using the association rule algorithm to associate and classify user behaviors, our scheme formulates abnormal behavior judgment standards, establishes an automated audit strategy knowledge base, and improves the security audit efficiency of power industrial control system operation support cloud platform. The intelligent level of log data analysis enables effective discovery, traceability and management of internal personnel operational risks.

articleTitle: Research on Personnel Precise Positioning System Based on UWB Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of personnel positioning, avoid the threat to the personal safety of workers in complex environments, and realize the real-time perception of the spatial location of personnel, this paper introduces UWB technology to develop a new personnel precise positioning system. According to the design requirements, the positioning system architecture is developed. Taking the server and tag equipment as an example, the hardware equipment selection of the system is carried out. Under the support of the hardware equipment, the UWB technology is introduced to carry out the personnel space ranging. The coordinate map conversion technology is introduced to correct and feedback the personnel positioning and ranging feedback information, and the development and design of the positioning system are completed. Taking an operation site as an example, an application experiment is designed. The experimental results show that the developed system has a high positioning accuracy for personnel in practical application, and the positioning deviation can be controlled within 1.5 m, which can provide comprehensive personal safety protection for operators under complex conditions.

articleTitle: A vulnerability scanning and verification system for power information systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Some of the power information system vulnerability scanning and verification system in the process of putting into use, there is a time-consuming defects, in order to design a new power information system vulnerability scanning and verification system. Hardware component: The FLASH chip is chosen as the tool for loading and guiding the main program in the system, expanding the addressing space range on the basis of the original chip capacity. Software part: Identifying security hazards in electric power information system logs, timely process alert information with homologous features, adopt the way of extracting the expected value of anomalous variables, update the maximum value of the lower bound of the initial distribution likelihood function, construct an alert mapping space using a Gaussian mixture clustering model, and optimize the system vulnerability scanning and verification mode with the help of a leakage scanning tool with integrated features. Test results: The time consumption of the power information system vulnerability scanning and verification system in this paper is 5.048min, 8.204min, 8.441min and 8.325min respectively compared to the other two power information system vulnerability scanning and verification systems, indicating that the power information system vulnerability scanning and verification system designed in this paper is more advantageous in terms of time consumption.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of UWB Data Transmission Algorithm for UAV Formation Flight Control
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: This project aims to solve the problem of data transmission of UAV Formation Flying, and studies UAV Formation Flying and intelligent positioning and navigation based on UWB positioning algorithm, and put forward a method by the fusion height-finding laser lidar data and TDOA algorithm data, and test the UAV Formation Flying planning, and achieve high precision, smooth and no deviation Formation Flying.

articleTitle: A residual combined attention mechanism based on U-Net network for kidney tumor image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: For the phenomenon that the kidney tumor target is small and difficult to segment, and the sample distribution is uneven, 3*3 residual convolution blocks are used to replace the 3*3 convolution of the original U-Net model. The problem of gradient disappearance is avoided while stabilizing the number of deepening layers to improve the effect of the model. The NAM (Normalization Attention Module) module is embedded in the upsampling process to enhance the network's ability to extract features. The proposed network achieves 0.917, 0.938, 0.921, 0.960 and 0.887 in terms of recall, Dice coefficient, IOU, F1 score and accuracy compared with other networks. It can be seen that the method proposed in this paper has improved the situation of small target misdetection and omission to a certain extent, and can effectively segment the kidney and tumour.

articleTitle: Optimisation and research of Los Angeles communication network hotspots based on machine learning and social software data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: With the development of the times, people have become more and more dependent on their mobile phones, while instant messaging has become a new and booming field recently, and social media plays an important role as a communication medium for people to communicate with each other and share their lives. Using Twitter data with various keywords, researchers can analyse when, where and what the tweets were posted. Machine learning can further analyse the local user traffic and the location where users often send data so that new fifth-generation (5G) base stations can be deployed. The innovation of this simulation is to use machine learning algorithms to cluster the Twitter user data in Los Angeles. Two clustering algorithms, DBSCAN and K-means, are used to optimise the simulation through parameter settings and contour functions to determine the value of K to determine the number of clusters needed in the local area. The clustering results are analysed and processed, and the 5G base stations are deployed in the city with fourth-generation(4G) base stations already covered, thus helping the operator to deploy base stations more accurately and saving the company's overhead. The optimal K-value for the algorithm was obtained through simulation, and targeted optimisation was made for some areas based on the local geographical location and the distribution of hotspots and blackspots of passenger traffic. The simulation improves the targeting of the signal base station deployment of the telecom operator company. Unlike the previous aim of pursuing full coverage of the area, this simulation hopes to analyse the hotspot and blackspot of the whole city through the existing communication data, so that the base station deployment can be guided by the data, which is a more direct and efficient method.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Network Intrusion Detection Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Network security is one of the most concerned issues today. Modern network attacks show a trend of technical complexity and diversification. Intrusion detection is an effective defense method to solve network security problems, but the accuracy and false alarm rate of traditional intrusion detection methods still have much room to improve, and it is difficult to accurately detect new types of attacks in real time, and the generalization is poor. This paper proposes the method of KNN and decision tree to establish machine learning model, and conducts simulation experiments on the classic dataset KDDCUP99. Combined with the experimental results of Bayes and BP neural network comparison models, it shows that KNN and decision tree have higher detection accuracy and reliability, and detection classification has more generalization and higher practicability. It also provides a reference for the application of KNN and decision tree machine learning methods in other big data detection classification.

articleTitle: AKPAVF: an Automatic Kernel Patch Applying and Verification Framework based on Virtualization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: The defects or vulnerabilities become inevitable for the Linux operating system kernel for its complexity and huge amount of codes. Meanwhile, it has always been a challenging task of patching and repairing a kernel vulnerability for the great cost of labor, resources and time. How to improve the efficiency of locating and repairing kernel vulnerabilities has become a focus. There are some contributions on automatic vulnerability locating and patch generating methods, however, the efficient method of repairing vulnerabilities is still in its infancy, especially for the problems of automatic kernel repair and patch generation. Focusing on the improvement of the automation of kernel vulnerability management, this paper proposes AKP A VF: An Automatic Kernel Patch Applying and Verification Framework based on virtualization. It designs a patch generation algorithm to enable the generation of kernel vulnerability patch set based on the vulnerability patch library, and performs the automatic patch applying and verification process based on KVM virtualization technology. The experimental verification shows that our work improves the automatic repair ability of operating system kernel vulnerabilities, reduces the manual intervention process, and improves the efficiency of patch verification.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation Algorithm Based on Local Dynamic Transformation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: This aimed at the problem of insufficient samples of training datasets for deep convolutional neural networks in computer vision tasks, which may easily lead to over-fitting, a Gaussian Adjusted Local Dynamic Transform (GA-LDT) data enhancement algorithm based on Gaussian adjustment was proposed. The distribution characteristics of the function perform a local dynamic transformation on the image, enhance the difference and diversity of image information, and alleviate the problem of overfitting. To verify the algorithm's effectiveness, comparative experiments on ResNet, Yolox, and Espnet networks suitable for different tasks are carried out on CIFAR-100, CIFAR-10, Pascal VOC, and Cityscapes data sets, respectively. After using the GA-LDT algorithm, the accuracy of the ResNet network on CIFAR-100 and CIFAR-10 data sets has increased by 3.86% and 7.61%, respectively, year-on-year. Yolox network uses GA-LDT algorithm, and the mAP on Pascal VOC dataset is increased by 1.86% year-on-year, while the mloU on Cityscapes dataset of Espnet network using GA-LDT algorithm is increased by 0.51% year-on-year.

articleTitle: Research on Capturing Random Burst Signals of Power Satellite Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: Aiming at the random access technology which has great application prospect in power satellite Internet of Things, the random burst signal acquisition method is studied. The key problem of random burst signal acquisition is the detection of the existence of random burst signal. Firstly, the existence detection problem of random burst signals with precursors is modeled as a composite hypothesis testing problem. The signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) estimation method in the detection problem is analyzed quantitatively, and the calculation method of the theoretical upper bound of the detection performance is analyzed. Then, based on the generalized likelihood ratio (GLRT) test theory, a constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detector is designed, and the engineering implementation method of the detector is derived. Finally, four simulation experiments prove that the method has good detection performance and adaptability to received signal power fluctuations.

articleTitle: A Federated Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Approach to Secure Resource Allocation in Power Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Information Processing and Cloud Computing (AIIPCC)
abstract: In order to alleviate the shortcomings of the current power communication network resource security allocation method, which has a large service blockage rate, a federal deep reinforcement learning-based power communication network resource security allocation method is designed. Using the maximum throughput rate as a reference, the network resource target is obtained using beam assignment, a priority classification model for power communication services is constructed, spectrum utilisation is improved, a shared protocol is established to upload training data and a secure resource allocation method is designed based on a federal deep reinforcement learning algorithm. Experimental results: The average value of service blockage rate of the power communication network resource security allocation method in the paper is 27.374%, which indicates that this designed power communication network resource security allocation method is more applicable after combining with the federal deep reinforcement learning algorithm.
